findings.title: Release engineering 정전 = Adams/McIntosh 6-phase 파이프라인 + Humble/Farley deployment pipeline + SRE 4 principles + DevOps Three Ways + SAFe Release Train
findings.claim: 현 SYMPOSIUM CHANNELS.md는 Adams & McIntosh의 phase 5(release)와 SRE의 hermetic build 원칙은 충실하나, phase 6(post-release monitoring)과 release-train cadence 메타포는 부재. 이는 SYMPOSIUM이 event-driven(skill-creator 호출 시) 모델이기 때문 — 의도적 설계이되 명시 필요.

evidence.source: Adams & McIntosh, 'Modern Release Engineering in a Nutshell — Why Researchers Should Care', SANER 2016 (NOT IEEE Software, 현 CHANNELS 인용 보정 필요)
evidence.quote: Recent practices of continuous delivery, which bring new content to the end user in days or hours rather than months or years, have generated a surge of industry-driven interest in the release engineering pipeline.
evidence.claim: Release engineering = 6-phase pipeline (branch/CI/build/deploy/release/monitor)

evidence.quote: Deployment Pipeline: an automated process for managing all changes, from check-in to release.
evidence.claim: 4 핵심 원칙: build-once / deploy-same-way / smoke-test / stop-the-line

evidence.source: Google SRE Book — 'Release Engineering' chapter (Dinah McNutt, 2016)
evidence.quote: Google's builds are hermetic, meaning that they are insensitive to the libraries and other software installed on the build machine.
evidence.claim: 4 SRE principles: self-service / high velocity / hermetic / policy enforcement

evidence.source: Kim et al., Phoenix Project / DevOps Handbook
evidence.quote: Three Ways: Flow / Feedback / Continuous learning
evidence.claim: Release engineering motivation = First Way (좌→우 흐름)

evidence.quote: ART is a metaphor for a long-lived, self-organizing team of Agile teams ... like a train on its tracks, moves along a predetermined path and schedule.
evidence.claim: Release Train = fixed cadence + standard velocity + predictable releases

findings.implication: CHANNELS.md에 (1) Adams 인용 출처 SANER 2016으로 보정, (2) phase 6(post-release monitoring)을 channel 강등 메커니즘으로 명시, (3) event-driven vs cadence-driven 모델 선택 의도 명시.

findings.title: Chrome 5채널/1-5%→100% gradual rollout이 가장 영향력 큰 reference. Firefox 4채널, Microsoft 2026-04 단순화(Experimental+Beta), Anthropic per-feature env-var kill switch, AGENTS.md cross-tool 표준, Argo Rollouts step weights, OpenFeature CNCF Incubating spec v0.8.0 — 산업 합의 명확.
findings.claim: 현 SYMPOSIUM 3채널은 적정(41 skill 규모엔 5채널 과함)이나 (1) per-skill rollout %, (2) per-feature kill switch, (3) merkle_root drift detection, (4) marketplace.json publish, (5) OpenFeature provider integration이 부재. Microsoft 2026-04(이번 달!) Experimental+Beta 단순화는 'channel coarse + feature flag fine' 분리 트렌드 명시.

evidence.quote: Initially, only a small number of users for each release channel get an update — maybe only 1–5% to start, gradually building up to 100%.
evidence.claim: Chrome 5채널 (Canary daily / Dev 1-2x weekly / Beta weekly / Stable 2-3주 / Extended Stable 8주) + 1-5% gradual rollout

evidence.quote: 3 primary code branches (firefox-main, firefox-beta, firefox-release) + ESR separate product
evidence.claim: Firefox 4채널 (Nightly 12h / Beta 4w / Release 4w / ESR 52w major) + uplift workflow

evidence.quote: We're moving to Experimental and Beta — the Experimental channel takes the place of the former Dev and Canary channels.
evidence.claim: MS 2026-04 단순화 = channel 줄이고 feature flag로 fine-grained 이동

evidence.quote: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1 disables experimental Beta headers; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY ... 6+ remote killswitches
evidence.claim: Anthropic 패턴 = per-feature env-var kill switch (per-channel 아님). SYMPOSIUM은 channel-level 1개만 채택.

evidence.quote: claude plugin marketplace add http://your-marketplace-url/claude-code/marketplace.json — 2026 Q1 official 101 plugins, ecosystem 507+
evidence.claim: marketplace.json schema 표준 (name + owner + plugins[])

evidence.source: AGENTS.md spec (Linux Foundation Agentic AI Foundation steward)
evidence.quote: AGENTS.md is the cross-tool standard. Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Amp, Devin all read AGENTS.md natively.
evidence.claim: Cross-tool 표준 — 6+ agent CLI native 지원, monorepo nested 'nearest wins'

evidence.quote: setWeight: percentage of traffic to canary; pause: manual or auto-analysis. Sample steps: 1% → 5% → 20% → 50% → 100%.
evidence.claim: 표준 progressive rollout step weights

evidence.quote: CNCF Sandbox 2022-06 → Incubating 2023-11. Spec v0.8.0 (2026): evaluation context, hooks, events, A/B tracking, multi-provider.
evidence.claim: Vendor-neutral feature flag spec — LaunchDarkly/Flagsmith/Statsig/DevCycle 모두 provider 구현

findings.implication: Tier 1: (a) Chrome-style 1-5%→100% per-skill rollout, (b) per-skill kill switch env var (SYMPOSIUM_DISABLE_<NAME>=1), (c) AGENTS.md에 CHANNELS.md cross-ref. Tier 2: OpenFeature provider integration, marketplace.json publish.

findings.title: Big Bang Release / Release Freeze Fatigue / Channel Drift / Skip-Level Upgrade / Kill Switch Failure / Feature Flag Debt — 6 antipattern. 현 CHANNELS.md는 Channel Drift는 인지(stable→regression→beta 강등) but Feature Flag Debt / Kill Switch DR test 부재.
findings.claim: Big Bang/Freeze는 SYMPOSIUM 규모(41 skill, 분산 작성자 적음)에선 약한 함정. 진짜 위험은 (1) Channel Drift(stable의 regression이 누적되어 beta가 더 안정), (2) Feature Flag Debt(channel:experimental인데 더 이상 사용 안 됨), (3) Kill Switch DR 미검증(CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS 자체가 작동 안 하면? game day 부재).

evidence.quote: Big-bang deployments require coordination of many people and 'moving parts'... result in significant downtime when users cannot use the system.
evidence.claim: Big Bang antipattern: long-lived branches → integration day → defect risk + downtime

evidence.source: Wikipedia Freeze (software engineering) + Reliably SRE blog
evidence.quote: Code freezes ... not widely accepted in Agile framework... brings down software quality and slows production release.
evidence.claim: Release Freeze Fatigue: 동결 직전 rush + 동결 중 누적 → 해제 시 폭발. CI/CD 성숙 시 feature flag로 대체.

evidence.quote: stable / candidate / beta / edge channels indicate stability — implicit understanding that channel drift = inversion of stability ordering
evidence.claim: Channel Drift: stable hot-fix lane이 부족하면 critical fix가 stable에 못 들어가 beta가 사실상 더 안정 (학문 paper 직접 출처 없음, industry folklore)

evidence.quote: K8s allows skip 1 minor version maximum
evidence.claim: Skip-Level Upgrade 위험: v1→v2 직행 시 breaking change pile-up. SYMPOSIUM skill version도 동일 위험.

evidence.quote: Hystrix is currently in maintenance mode... Netflix recommends others leverage open and active projects like resilience4j
evidence.claim: Kill switch는 자체로 의존성 — config 서비스 down/test 안 됨이면 무력화. Chaos engineering 정기 검증 필요.

evidence.quote: Flag debt compounds faster than technical debt because each stale flag adds two code paths that both need testing and maintenance.
evidence.claim: Feature Flag Debt: stale flag = 2× test/maint surface. 'Launched' status 자동 archive 필요.

findings.implication: 현 SYMPOSIUM 우선 함정 = (1) Channel Drift(이미 인지, ✓), (2) Kill Switch DR 미검증(game day 도입), (3) channel:experimental skill의 Flag Debt(expiration date / Lesson 기반 자동 cleanup). Big Bang/Freeze는 41-skill 규모엔 낮은 위험.

findings.title: 2026 trend = (a) MS 채널 단순화로 channel coarse + flag fine 분리, (b) AGENTS.md cross-tool 표준 정착, (c) marketplace.json plugin 생태계, (d) LLM-as-Judge release readiness gate, (e) SLSA/in-toto merkle attestation, (f) OpenFeature CNCF Incubating 표준.
findings.claim: SYMPOSIUM의 channel + Taliban + skill-validator 조합은 LLM-as-Judge release gate의 직접 implementation이지만 정량 score(75-90% match, Spearman ≥0.80) 명시 없음. SLSA-style merkle_root drift detection / OpenFeature provider / marketplace.json publish가 다음 진화 방향. Microsoft 2026-04(이번 달) Experimental+Beta 통합은 SYMPOSIUM 3채널 유지 vs 2채널(Beta+Stable) 단순화 선택지를 제시.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Simplifies Windows Insider Program to Two Channels and Ends Gradual Feature Rollouts in Beta — replaced by feature flags
evidence.claim: 2026 트렌드: channel 수 줄이고 feature flag로 fine-grained 이동

evidence.quote: AGENTS.md is the cross-tool standard. One file, every agent.
evidence.claim: AGENTS.md = 2026 사실상 표준, Linux Foundation steward

evidence.quote: Official marketplace = 101 plugins, ecosystem 507+
evidence.claim: Plugin marketplace 생태계 성숙 — SYMPOSIUM 41 skill publish 가능 단계

evidence.quote: 75-90% match between judge and human labels indicates strong alignment and readiness to scale ... aim for 0.80+ Spearman correlation
evidence.claim: Release readiness 정량 기준: judge-human 75-90% / Spearman ≥0.80 → CI/CD release gate 통합

evidence.quote: SLSA software attestation is an authenticated, machine-readable statement (metadata) generated in the in-toto ITE-6 format during the signing process.
evidence.claim: Merkle root content-addressable hash → drift 감지 → 자동 channel 강등. SLSA Level 2+ provenance attestation.

evidence.quote: Spec v0.8.0 covers evaluation context, hooks, events, tracking for A/B tests, transaction context propagation, and multi-provider support.
evidence.claim: Vendor-neutral provider abstraction → LaunchDarkly/Flagsmith/Statsig 동시 publish 가능

evidence.quote: Argo Rollouts can query and interpret metrics from various providers (Prometheus / Datadog / NewRelic) to verify key KPIs and drive automated promotion or rollback during an update.
evidence.claim: Per-step metric gate + auto promotion/rollback — SYMPOSIUM channel transition에 직접 적용 가능

findings.implication: Tier 1 권장: (1) AGENTS.md ↔ CHANNELS.md cross-ref, (2) merkle_root in MANIFEST.json for drift detection, (3) per-skill SYMPOSIUM_DISABLE_<NAME> kill switch. Tier 2: OpenFeature provider, LLM-as-Judge 정량 score(≥0.80 Spearman) channel transition gate, progressive 1%→5%→25%→100% per-skill rollout. Tier 3: marketplace.json publish, kill switch chaos engineering game day.
